# Deep Research Intelligence Packet

## Cycle metadata

- Packet ID: `dr-20260922-1906-altametrics-validation`
- Research system: `ChatGPT Deep Research`
- Started at: `2026-09-22 19:06 CDT`
- Completed at: `2026-09-22 19:09 CDT`
- Research scope: Validate four first-party Altametrics customer, enterprise, and company pages.
- Queue item or vendor: Altametrics
- Methodology: Direct competitor customer-page validation, with brand, product, scope, confidence, and currentness limitations preserved.

## Executive result

- Pages reviewed: 4
- Candidate pages validated: 4
- Brand-vendor-product observations added or revised: 8
- Conflicts found: 2
- Material takeaway: Altametrics publishes strong first-party evidence across workforce management, food management, inventory, forecasting, scheduling, business intelligence, and enterprise back-office use. Named executive and operator testimonials support real deployments, but several claims have unclear dates or franchisee-only scope and should not be generalized into current brand-wide installed-base facts.

## Evidence observations

### Observation 1 — Chicken Salad Chick

- Brand: Chicken Salad Chick
- Vendor: Altametrics
- Product or category: Forecasting, scheduling, labor deployment, break management, and cross-training
- Relationship indication: customer
- Deployment scope: enterprise
- Evidence type: testimonial
- Confidence: 90%
- Confidence rationale: First-party customer page attributes the statement to the brand's VP of Company Operations and describes concrete operational use. Page publication date and rollout size are not stated.
- Source title: Our Clients that Run with Altametrics
- Source URL: https://altametrics.com/customers.html
- Publisher or source owner: Altametrics
- Published date, if known: Unknown
- Accessed date: 2026-09-22
- Faithful factual note: The executive testimonial says Altametrics replaced spreadsheet-heavy work with improved forecasting, scheduling, labor deployment, break management, and cross-training.
- Product-specific evidence: Labor and workforce-management functions are explicit; the precise Altametrics module name is not.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Vendor-hosted testimonial; no location count or current rollout confirmation.
- Recommended follow-up: Seek a dated brand statement or implementation record.

### Observation 2 — Peet's Coffee

- Brand: Peet's Coffee
- Vendor: Altametrics
- Product or category: Inventory, receiving, order forecasting, analytics, and cost control
- Relationship indication: customer
- Deployment scope: enterprise
- Evidence type: testimonial
- Confidence: 90%
- Confidence rationale: First-party page identifies Peet's VP of Store Operations and describes concrete workflows, while the enterprise page separately describes supply-order forecasting.
- Source title: Our Clients that Run with Altametrics; Restaurant Enterprise Solutions
- Source URL: https://altametrics.com/customers.html
- Publisher or source owner: Altametrics
- Published date, if known: Unknown
- Accessed date: 2026-09-22
- Faithful factual note: The testimonial describes weekly inventory and receiving plus forecasted orders; the enterprise page says Altametrics supports Peet's supply ordering with forecast-based quantities.
- Product-specific evidence: Inventory, receiving, ordering, forecasting, analytics, and cost-control workflows.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Same-publisher corroboration, not independent evidence; no location count or dated current-state confirmation.
- Recommended follow-up: Find a dated Peet's technology or operations source.

### Observation 3 — Five Guys

- Brand: Five Guys
- Vendor: Altametrics
- Product or category: Business intelligence and multi-currency reporting
- Relationship indication: customer
- Deployment scope: regional
- Evidence type: testimonial
- Confidence: 90%
- Confidence rationale: The named VP of Information Technology describes the Hong Kong team's ability to view business-intelligence reporting in U.S. dollars.
- Source title: Our Clients that Run with Altametrics
- Source URL: https://altametrics.com/customers.html
- Publisher or source owner: Altametrics
- Published date, if known: Unknown
- Accessed date: 2026-09-22
- Faithful factual note: The testimonial supports on-the-fly currency conversion in business-intelligence reporting for Five Guys' Hong Kong team.
- Product-specific evidence: Business intelligence and reporting are explicit.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Regional example only; it does not establish global deployment or present-day scope.
- Recommended follow-up: Confirm rollout scope outside Hong Kong.

### Observation 4 — Outback Steakhouse

- Brand: Outback Steakhouse
- Vendor: Altametrics
- Product or category: Food management
- Relationship indication: customer
- Deployment scope: enterprise
- Evidence type: testimonial
- Confidence: 90%
- Confidence rationale: A named chief business officer describes the food-management products as integral to operations.
- Source title: Our Clients that Run with Altametrics
- Source URL: https://altametrics.com/customers.html
- Publisher or source owner: Altametrics
- Published date, if known: Unknown
- Accessed date: 2026-09-22
- Faithful factual note: The executive testimonial characterizes Altametrics food-management products as embedded in the way the business operates.
- Product-specific evidence: Food management is explicit; features and rollout count are not.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Vendor-hosted and undated; no independent current confirmation.
- Recommended follow-up: Locate a dated Outback or Bloomin' Brands operations source.

### Observation 5 — McDonald's

- Brand: McDonald's
- Vendor: Altametrics
- Product or category: Workforce management and labor-cost visibility
- Relationship indication: customer
- Deployment scope: unknown
- Evidence type: customer story
- Confidence: 75%
- Confidence rationale: Altametrics directly calls McDonald's its biggest customer and separately describes workforce-management use, but neither page states whether this is corporate, regional, or franchisee scope.
- Source title: Restaurant Enterprise Solutions; About Us
- Source URL: https://altametrics.com/restaurant-enterprise.html
- Publisher or source owner: Altametrics
- Published date, if known: Unknown; company statistics elsewhere on the About page are explicitly dated 2023
- Accessed date: 2026-09-22
- Faithful factual note: Altametrics says McDonald's operators use its workforce-management capability for labor-cost visibility and calls McDonald's its biggest customer.
- Product-specific evidence: Workforce management and labor-cost visibility are explicit.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Scope is unspecified, and the first-party narrative does not prove corporate or systemwide adoption.
- Recommended follow-up: Identify named operator, market, or current deployment count.

### Observation 6 — Taco Bell

- Brand: Taco Bell
- Vendor: Altametrics
- Product or category: Business-intelligence reporting
- Relationship indication: customer
- Deployment scope: franchisee
- Evidence type: testimonial
- Confidence: 85%
- Confidence rationale: A named Taco Bell franchisee describes business-intelligence use, and the enterprise page describes multi-restaurant reporting. Franchisee scope is the strongest defensible reading.
- Source title: Our Clients that Run with Altametrics; Restaurant Enterprise Solutions
- Source URL: https://altametrics.com/customers.html
- Publisher or source owner: Altametrics
- Published date, if known: Unknown
- Accessed date: 2026-09-22
- Faithful factual note: The franchisee testimonial says Altametrics business intelligence helps operators identify where attention is needed; the enterprise page describes consolidated reporting across multiple restaurants.
- Product-specific evidence: Business intelligence and multi-restaurant reporting.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: No named franchise organization, location count, or brand-wide scope.
- Recommended follow-up: Identify the franchisee organization and footprint.

### Observation 7 — Pizza Hut

- Brand: Pizza Hut
- Vendor: Altametrics
- Product or category: Restaurant inventory management and reporting
- Relationship indication: customer
- Deployment scope: unknown
- Evidence type: customer story
- Confidence: 70%
- Confidence rationale: The direct vendor page makes a product-specific relationship claim, but provides no named executive, geography, franchisee, location count, or date.
- Source title: Restaurant Enterprise Solutions
- Source URL: https://altametrics.com/restaurant-enterprise.html
- Publisher or source owner: Altametrics
- Published date, if known: Unknown
- Accessed date: 2026-09-22
- Faithful factual note: Altametrics says Pizza Hut uses its restaurant inventory-management software and reporting aligned to day-to-day operating needs.
- Product-specific evidence: Inventory management and reporting are explicit.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Scope and currentness are unknown; the page is marketing copy without a named testimonial.
- Recommended follow-up: Seek a dated Pizza Hut, Yum, or franchisee source.

### Observation 8 — Jack in the Box

- Brand: Jack in the Box
- Vendor: Altametrics
- Product or category: Restaurant back office, workforce management, and food management
- Relationship indication: customer
- Deployment scope: franchisee
- Evidence type: testimonial and customer story
- Confidence: 85%
- Confidence rationale: A named Hemet franchisee testimonial and the enterprise page support long-running use; the About page says the original product was built for the founder's family franchise.
- Source title: Our Clients that Run with Altametrics; Restaurant Enterprise Solutions; About Us
- Source URL: https://altametrics.com/customers.html
- Publisher or source owner: Altametrics
- Published date, if known: Unknown
- Accessed date: 2026-09-22
- Faithful factual note: Altametrics describes decades of Jack in the Box back-office use spanning workforce and food management, while the named franchisee testimonial emphasizes usability.
- Product-specific evidence: Back office, workforce management, and food management.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Franchisee and vendor-origin story do not prove current systemwide corporate adoption.
- Recommended follow-up: Confirm current corporate-versus-franchise deployment scope.

## Negative findings

- Candidate or claim: Brand logos on the full-service restaurant page prove current deployment.
- Pages checked: https://altametrics.com/industries/fullservicerestaurants.html
- Result: The page repeats customer references and displays additional logos, but a logo alone is not sufficient to infer a current, product-specific relationship. No new mapping was created solely from the logo wall.

- Candidate or claim: Vendor-wide customer-count claims establish brand-level deployment counts.
- Pages checked: https://altametrics.com/customers.html; https://altametrics.com/restaurant-enterprise.html
- Result: The pages variously refer to more than 100,000 restaurants, 100,000+ customers, and 1,000,000+ restaurant professionals. These measures are not directly comparable and do not establish the installed footprint for any named brand.

## Source ledger

| URL | Source type | Accessed | Supports observation(s) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| https://altametrics.com/customers.html | Customer testimonial page | 2026-09-22 | 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 | Named executives/operators and product workflows; undated vendor-hosted evidence. |
| https://altametrics.com/restaurant-enterprise.html | Enterprise customer page | 2026-09-22 | 2, 5, 6, 7, 8 | Product-specific brand narratives; scope and currentness vary. |
| https://altametrics.com/about.html | Company history | 2026-09-22 | 5, 8 | Historical customer narrative; page includes company metrics dated 2023. |
| https://altametrics.com/industries/fullservicerestaurants.html | Industry and logo page | 2026-09-22 | None independently | Repeats customer references and contains a logo wall; not treated as standalone deployment proof. |

## Research notes and inferences

- Inference: Altametrics has meaningful restaurant-enterprise breadth, but its public evidence mixes corporate, regional, location-level, and franchisee relationships. These must remain separate in canonical review.
- Inference: Named executive testimonials provide stronger evidence than the logo wall or generic brand narratives, but their undated publication limits claims about a current 2026 installed base.
- Conflict: Altametrics' public scale statements use different units and magnitudes (restaurants, customers, users, and professionals), so none should be treated as a precise installed-base count without clarification.
- Conflict: Some brand descriptions read enterprise-wide while the named evidence is franchisee or regional. The packet therefore preserves unknown or franchisee scope instead of upgrading to systemwide deployment.
